QuestInfo.name: [Verne Mine] The Truth
QuestInfo.0: Learn more about #m310000000#'s watchman, #p2152018#. Speak to #b#p2152002##k.
QuestInfo.1:
According to #p2152002#, #p2152018# is originally from #m310000000#. He forced himself to become a part of the Black Wings, because he wanted to keep on eye on #p2154004#, his former lover currently being held hostage.

He says you should go to the walls of the mansion at 10 o'clock at night if you want to confirm his story about #p2152018#. According to him, you will find #p2152018#, waiting patiently for his love #p2154004# to return.
QuestInfo.2: You returned after seeing #p2152018#. #p2152002# said that #p2152018# really wants to protect the town from the Black Wings, but can't, because #p2154004# is being held hostage. #p2152002# added that many people think #p2152018# betrayed his own town... #p2152002# said he hopes you don't think that, too.
